name: Add Task To Section
description: Add a task to a specific, existing section. This will remove the task from other sections of the project. [See the documentation](https://developers.asana.com/docs/add-task-to-section)

configurable_props.name: project
configurable_props.label: Project
configurable_props.description: List of projects. This field uses the project GID.

configurable_props.name: task
configurable_props.label: Task
configurable_props.description: The task to add to this section.

configurable_props.name: section_gid
configurable_props.label: Section GID
configurable_props.description: The globally unique identifier for the section.

configurable_props.name: insert_before
configurable_props.label: Insert Before
configurable_props.description: An existing task within this section before which the added task should be inserted. Cannot be provided together with insert_after.

configurable_props.name: insert_after
configurable_props.label: Insert After
configurable_props.description: An existing task within this section after which the added task should be inserted. Cannot be provided together with insert_before.
